glance_takeaway: A blameless post-incident analysis of INC-1194, a SEV-1 partial outage of ledgerline's invoicing API on June 24, 2026 (14:02-18:19 UTC, 4h17m). Main message: three failures had to align - a search-query regression from a deploy (trigger), pre-existing autovacuum debt, and jitterless client retries exhausting a shared 80-connection database pool - and removing any one leg would have left only a degradation. Also legible: 31.2% peak error rate, 2,312 orgs affected (~24%), ~$41,300 SLA credits, zero data lost, 68 minutes to correct diagnosis (50 on a wrong network theory, alerting watched error rate not latency), rollback impossible so a feature flag stopped the bleeding at 17:05, and three P0 fixes landing in Q3 2026.

F11.note: Tab 2 + pill + timeline: network hypothesis 14:20-15:10 (50 min) anchored by 14:05 provider advisory, 504s resembling network timeouts, deploy markers broken since June 10; 68 min from 14:11 alert to 15:19 diagnosis.

strengths: Perfect fact coverage: all 16 key facts are present and numerically exact, most in both a glance-level and an evidence-level form.

Above-the-fold zone alone carries all four critical takeaways: headline/lede state the three-leg conjunction, stat tiles carry impact, and three pills cover detection lag, rollback impossibility, and the Q3 2026 P0 plan.

The counterfactual toggle section is a genuinely explanatory device - it makes 'no single root cause' operational rather than asserted, with per-leg counterfactuals that match the source's estimates (~26 s bloat-free, ~34/80 connections).
Time-spent bar honestly encodes the 257 minutes with flex values proportional to actual durations; the 50 m detour and 106 m mitigation hunt visually dominate as the source intends.

Audience fit per brief is excellent: every DB-specific mechanism (dead tuples, autovacuum, covering index, pooling, jitter, statement timeout, p99) has a one-line hover gloss, and a no-JS fallback shows all hidden content.

Caveats survive: 'completed requests only', 'seen only in retrospect', 'estimated ~26 s', 'representative query plans', 'disk marked reusable, not returned', and the blameless framing is kept throughout.
weaknesses: Heavy reliance on progressive disclosure: the three cause-evidence panels are collapsed by default and 3 of 4 deep-dive tabs are hidden, so the resting page conceals most of the quantitative evidence and the entire fix table; a reader who never clicks gets summaries only.
Re-finding specifics is mediocre: no table of contents or anchor links, and content inside collapsed cards/tabs cannot be found with browser text search until opened.
Hover-only glosses and time-bar tooltips are awkward on touch devices (tabindex helps keyboard users, but tap behavior is unreliable for CSS :hover tooltips).
The narrow time-bar segments (9 m bands) carry no visible label at rest; the reader must consult the legend or hover.

A few details (e.g. 'checkout had a latency SLO alert; invoicing did not', the 14:55 status-page cadence) go beyond key_facts.md and could not be verified against ground truth, though nothing contradicts it.
